title: 缩放点积注意力（含因果掩码）
code:
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(7)
Q = np.random.randn(1, 4, 8)
K = np.random.randn(1, 4, 8)
V = np.random.randn(1, 4, 8)
d_k = 8
scores = Q @ K.transpose(0,2,1) / np.sqrt(d_k)        # (1,4,4)
T = scores.shape[-1]
mask = np.triu(np.ones((T,T)), k=1).astype(bool)      # 未来位置
scores_masked = np.where(mask, -1e9, scores)
m = scores_masked.max(-1, keepdims=True)
e = np.exp(scores_masked - m)
attn = e / e.sum(-1, keepdims=True)
out = attn @ V
print("缩放后 scores(前2位小数):")
print(np.round(scores[0], 2))
print("因果掩码后注意力权重(每行和应=1, 未来=0):")
print(np.round(attn[0], 3))
print("注意力权重行和:", np.round(attn.sum(-1)[0], 6))
print("输出形状:", out.shape)
print("未来位置权重严格为 0 ->", bool(np.all(attn[0][np.triu(np.ones((T,T),dtype=bool),k=1)] == 0)))
